title: Push payload tests assert constants instead of exercising payload generation code
reasoning: These tests build the expected payloads and route map directly inside the test file, then assert those same literals equal themselves. A production regression in the admin form or JavaScript mapping would not fail these tests because no real generator, form, view, template, or static asset is imported or executed.
recommendation: Exercise the actual payload-generation surface, such as the admin form/view/template JavaScript source or the Python helper that produces notification payloads, and compare its output to the expected route structures.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current assertions are self-referential; they validate the test data, not application behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Instantiate the real push-notification admin form or call the real payload builder for each content type, then assert outputs such as prayer_request -> prayer-request and video -> learn/video/<id>.
minimumFixScope: Replace the literal-only tests in notifications/tests/test_push_payload_generation.py with tests against the actual payload generation implementation.
